summary: Implementation is correct, minimal, and well-scoped. All 5 specific checks (M1, M1-zero, M1-both-paths, M6-log-level, M8-comparison) pass. 243 tests pass; M1 fix verified empirically with all-wins/all-losses/mixed-wins/empty fixtures. Minor cosmetic and test-coverage notes are non-blocking.

evidence: cpu_engine.py:648: `if pos["net_pnl"] > 0:` increments `sym_wins[sym]`. Win = profit > 0 at close (release time), not signal. Correct semantics.
0-PnL (breakeven) trades are correctly excluded from both wins and losses.
cpu_engine.py:1111: `s_win_rate = (s_wins / s_trades * 100.0) if s_trades > 0 else 0.0` — no division-by-zero.
Loop is `for sym in sym_trades:`, so `s_trades` is always >= 1 in iteration; the `> 0` guard is defensive but harmless.
Empirical: empty entry list returns `per_symbol_metrics={}` with no error.
Both `simulate_rule_set` (line 753) and `simulate_rule_set_slice` (line 751) call `_simulate_rule_set_entries(..., return_logs=False, ...)` — the path that had the bug.
`simulate_rule_batch` (line 1220) also funnels through the same `_simulate_rule_set_entries`. Single-rule path = batch path = rule-set path for the per-symbol metrics computation.
Both `_release_due_positions` call sites (lines 934 and 1070) now pass `sym_wins=sym_wins`.
`_release_due_positions` keeps `sym_wins: dict[str, int] | None = None` default so external callers without the dict don't break.
evox_runner.py:1233 and 1290 use `logger.debug(...)` for the new cache-size log lines. NOT `logger.info`. Will not spam the info log.

Spec said 'at gen 0 (or first eval)'; implementer added the log in BOTH branches of `_evaluate_population_indices` (cache-only path and GPU-batch path). This is slightly more verbose than spec but provides visibility regardless of which path runs. Still debug-level, so non-spammy.
Test ran at log level INFO — no cache lines appeared in test output. Confirmed debug-level only.
phase2_rule_pool.py:1883: `if ratio >= min_profitable_ratio:` — correct boundary inclusion (ratio == min_ratio passes, as expected).
M8 config flag `PHASE2_MONTHLY_ADMISSION_MIN_RATIO = 0.667` is the new default for the non-island path (line 572).
Island path (line 1860-1863) uses `island_hyperparams.monthly_admission_min_profitable_ratio` (default 0.667 fallback). Island path is unchanged from prior behavior.

Empirical test: a rule with 3/6 = 0.5 profitable months is correctly REJECTED under the new 0.667 threshold; graceful degradation returns the original pool (verified by direct call to `_apply_monthly_admission_gate`).
All-winning dataset: per_symbol_metrics = {A: win_rate=100.00, B: win_rate=100.00} (was 0.0 in pre-fix).
All-losing dataset: per_symbol_metrics = {LOSE: win_rate=0.00}.
Mixed dataset: {WINNER: win_rate=100.00, LOSER: win_rate=0.00} — per-symbol win_rate correctly reflects per-symbol outcomes.
Empty dataset: per_symbol_metrics = {} (no error, no division by zero).
243/243 relevant tests pass in 84s (1 pre-existing unrelated deselect).
M8 test updates correctly model the new 0.667 threshold: boundary cases (0.5, 0.33) now expected to fail; graceful degradation is exercised.

M1 fix has NO new direct unit test. Existing `test_property_28_per_symbol_metrics_consistency` only checks trade_count and net_pnl, not win_rate. The bug is structurally unlikely to regress now (the if/else branch is straightforward and `sym_wins` is now plumbed through), so a dedicated regression test is nice-to-have, not a blocker. Recommend adding one in a follow-up cleanup task.

M8 tests rely on the actual config value (0.667) and don't monkeypatch the new flag. A future revert of the config flag would silently pass the tests. Recommend adding `monkeypatch.setattr(_cfg, 'PHASE2_MONTHLY_ADMISSION_MIN_RATIO', 0.667)` for explicitness. Non-blocking.
Diff is 115 ins / 42 del across 7 files — no dead code added.

AGENTS.md 'remove wasted/old implementation' rule satisfied: old hardcoded 0.500 was replaced (not duplicated), old comment 'cannot compute without per-trade outcome tracking' was removed (not preserved alongside the new code).
evaluator_v5.ipynb confirmed unchanged (not in diff).
data/splitter.py confirmed unchanged (not in diff, M2 was investigation-only).

out_of_scope_check.notes: Diff matches the 7 files in the implementer handoff exactly. No unrelated refactors, no scope creep.

verdict_rationale: All 5 specific checks (M1 win-condition, M1 zero-safety, M1 both-paths, M6 debug-level, M8 ratio-comparison) PASS. Empirical M1 verification confirms per-symbol win_rate is correctly computed in the non-log path. M2 investigation is well-documented with split boundaries, regime-flip table, and a clear recommendation. M6 cache log is at debug level (not info) so won't spam. M8 0.667 threshold is correctly enforced with graceful degradation. The 4 minor notes are all LOW severity (stale docstring/comment, missing regression test, log-every-gen vs gen-0) and non-blocking.
